changeSet.author: osmontero
changeSet.comment: Vacate colliding utm_dashboard_visualization ids 1584..1600 before 20261012002_add_gap_dashboards runs.
changeSet.sql:
WITH base AS ( SELECT GREATEST(1000000, COALESCE((SELECT max(id) FROM utm_dashboard_visualization), 999999) + 1) AS b ), targets AS ( SELECT id AS old_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY id) AS i FROM utm_dashboard_visualization WHERE id BETWEEN 1584 AND 1600 AND (id_dashboard IS NULL OR id_dashboard NOT IN (403, 404, 405)) ) UPDATE utm_dashboard_visualization AS dv SET id = base.b + targets.i - 1 FROM targets, base WHERE dv.id = targets.old_id;
SELECT setval('utm_dashboard_visualization_id_seq', GREATEST(1000000, COALESCE((SELECT max(id) FROM utm_dashboard_visualization), 999999)), true);
